relevance_note: Single-patient case report of HA20 with individual-level detail: the infant's variant is printed ('revealing a heterozygous mutation in the TNFAIP3 gene at chr6:138200458–138200459, NM_001270508.2:c.1876_1877del (p.Leu626ValfsTer45)') together with symptoms, laboratory results and treatment.
method_note: No script transcribed any table; every span was copied from the Markdown file and checked with a verbatim text search. Scope: one case report, so the infant is 'patient' (label rule 5, the single unnamed patient of a case report); the two parents (Sanger-tested) and the two half-brothers are in scope as relatives described in relation to him. The previously published patients of Iwasa (12) and Zhang (7) are in scope because the Discussion gives individual-level facts (sex and age or onset period and features); other citations (e.g. Zhou (1)) give none and get no rows; their labels follow rule 4, using the reference number as printed in the text, '(12)' and '(7)'. NON-ASCII SPACES: the file uses thin/four-per-em spaces inside values such as '93 g/L', '2.5 cm', '153.1 U/L' and the ACMG string 'PVS1 + PS_Moderate + PS4_Supporting + PM2_Supporting'. Those characters cannot be reproduced in this output, so for such cells the span is an adjacent ASCII-only fragment (e.g. '| Hemoglobin | **93', 'with the liver palpable 2.5', 'According to the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics guidelines, the variant was classified as pathogenic') and the value is written with ordinary spaces; the legend 'The bold values provided in Table 1 indicates abnormal results.' is quoted where bold marks a value abnormal. DISCREPANCIES IN THE PAPER: the abstract prints the variant as 'c.1876_1877del (p. Leu626ValfsTer45)' while the case text prints 'NM_001270508.2:c.1876_1877del (p.Leu626ValfsTer45)'; Figure 4 prints 'NM_001270508.2c.1876_1877del' without a colon; the variant row uses the case-text form. NORMAL FINDINGS: 'Cardiopulmonary examination was normal' is a normal examination as a whole, so nothing was excluded from it; 'No abnormalities were detected in the anus or external genitalia' is recorded with the paper's own wording and, on that basis only, 'genital ulcers' is set excluded in the checklist. TEMPORAL FINDINGS: 'No new rashes or oral ulcers occurred, and liver enzymes remained normal' concerns the treated follow-up period, so the earlier findings stay observed and are not treated as a contradiction. GROUP/UNSPECIFIC STATEMENTS: the half-brothers' 'no similar medical history' names no feature, so nothing is excluded for them; stool, metagenomic, sputum (Enterobacter cloacae), COVID-19 and enterovirus results are pathogen findings rather than HA20 features, so 'recurrent infections' is left not reported. Splenomegaly is its own feature; 'lymphoproliferation or lymphadenopathy' is left not reported for it. 'cytopenia (autoimmune)' is left not reported although haemoglobin was low with a positive direct antiglobulin test, because the authors never state cytopenia. VARIANTS: rows are given only for the patient, because the paper prints no TNFAIP3 variant for the two previously published patients and both parents were tested negative (recorded as de novo inheritance with their testing quoted). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is false (no re-report of its own patient) and cohort_size_as_stated is null (the authors state no study total).
